issues.body:
This issue tracks all currently open bugs in the `taskflow-api` repository. Updated as of 2026-06-22.

## Open Bugs (3)

| # | Title | Severity | Comments |
|---|-------|----------|----------|
| #1 | [JWT secret falls back to hardcoded 'changeme' in production](https://github.com/hynes5090-cmyk/taskflow-api/issues/1) | 🔴 **urgent** | 3 |
| #3 | [Task deletion does not check ownership](https://github.com/hynes5090-cmyk/taskflow-api/issues/3) | 🟡 bug | 2 |
| #5 | [No input validation on POST /tasks](https://github.com/hynes5090-cmyk/taskflow-api/issues/5) | 🟡 bug | 2 |

## Summaries

### 🔴 #1 — JWT secret falls back to hardcoded 'changeme' in production
**Labels:** `bug`, `urgent`

In `src/auth.js`, the JWT secret defaults to the literal string `'changeme'` when `JWT_SECRET` is not set in the environment. This is a critical security vulnerability — anyone can forge auth tokens if the env var is ever missing in production. The app should throw an error at startup if `JWT_SECRET` is not set.

---

### 🟡 #3 — Task deletion does not check ownership
**Labels:** `bug`

`DELETE /tasks/:id` removes any task regardless of who is making the request. Any authenticated user can delete tasks owned by other users. Only the task creator or an admin should be able to delete a task.

---

### 🟡 #5 — No input validation on POST /tasks
**Labels:** `bug`

`POST /tasks` accepts any request body without validation — tasks can be created with no title, negative priority values, or arbitrary extra fields stored in memory. Required fields like `title` should be validated and malformed/unknown input should be rejected with a `400` error.

---

_This tracking issue will be closed once all referenced bugs are resolved._

issues.title: Add due date field to tasks
issues.body:
## Feature Request
Tasks currently have no due date. We need a `dueDate` field so users can track deadlines.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `POST /tasks` accepts a `dueDate` (ISO 8601 string)
- `GET /tasks` supports filtering by `?overdue=true`
- `PUT /tasks/:id` can update `dueDate`

issues.title: Add pagination to GET /tasks endpoint
issues.body:
## Feature Request
The `GET /tasks` endpoint returns all tasks with no limit. As the dataset grows this will become slow and return too much data.

## Proposed Solution
Add `page` and `limit` query parameters:

```
GET /tasks?page=2&limit=20
```

Response should include metadata:
```json
{
  "data": [...],
  "total": 120,
  "page": 2,
  "limit": 20
}
```

issues.title: JWT secret falls back to hardcoded 'changeme' in production
issues.body:
## Description
In `src/auth.js`, the JWT secret falls back to the string `'changeme'` if `JWT_SECRET` is not set:

```js
const SECRET = process.env.JWT_SECRET || 'changeme';
```

This is a serious security risk if the env var is ever missing in production.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Deploy without setting `JWT_SECRET`
2. Tokens are signed with a known secret — anyone can forge auth tokens

## Expected Behavior
App should refuse to start if `JWT_SECRET` is not set.

## Suggested Fix
Throw an error at startup if the env var is missing.

5.body: Starting work on this — will add Join validation to the POST handler

3.body: I can take this one. Will add an  check in the delete handler and return 403 if the requesting user doesn't match.

1.body: Confirmed this in staging — deployed without the env var set and tokens were signing with . Flagging as urgent, this needs a hotfix before the next release.

This issue has been logged in Jira for tracking and prioritization. It is marked as **Highest** priority given the active security risk of a known fallback secret in production.

**Jira ticket details:**
- Type: Bug
- Priority: Highest
- Labels: security, urgent

The recommended fix remains: throw a startup error if `JWT_SECRET` is not set, rather than silently falling back to a hardcoded value.
